utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-00-39-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Krajisnik. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. If there are no procedural issues, we could go into closed session and hear the testimony in cross-examination of Witness D9.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. We have no further witnesses for the week, Mr. Josse. The next witness was scheduled for the 5th of December --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: -- if I remember well. Although there are still quite a number of exhibits pending admission, perhaps it would be a waste of resources to schedule specifically a meeting -- a hearing tomorrow for that purpose, and let's try to find as soon as possible after the 5th or on the 5th time to deal with those matters, because otherwise the whole crew has to be present where we might find a lost moment at a later stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. JOSSE
utterances.text: That -- I have -- that would suit the Defence logistically enormously, I'm bound to say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Then we will adjourn until the 5th of December, 9.00 in the morning, in courtroom --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 5th day of December, 2005, at 9.00 a.m. 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.52 p.m.,
